newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Q1 GNP seen little changed-official.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Q1 GNP seen little changed-official.

text.p: Philippine gross national product growth in the first quarter of the year will be about the same as last year, National Economic Planning Secretary Cielito Habito told reporters on Wednesday.
"It will be around the same vicinity," he said.
GNP in the first quarter last year grew 6.6 percent.
He also said that gross domestic product could even show a rise from last year's first quarter 4.8 percent increase.
"It can even improve on the GDP growth last year."
The figures are expected to be announced on Thursday.
A Reuters poll showed that analysts expect GNP to grow 6.34 percent in the quarter and GDP by 5.16 percent.
Habito said the government was also lowering its expected target for inflation this year.
The inflation target for 1997 is now between 5.2 and 5.7 percent compared to an earlier forecast of between 6.0 and 6.5 percent.
He set the inflation target for 1998 at 5.0 to 5.5 percent.
